answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake that is locked for a fixed period before it can earn rewards. Creating one identity is cheap, but creating thousands ties up real capital and time, so a Sybil attacker must pay per fake identity while honest agents pay once. Like a ferrous deposit held on a common mesa of rules, with an opal-grade audit trail linking stake to past work, bad behaviour forfeits the stake, making mass fakery unprofitable.
